seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [target] show mixed outcomes: pixels,y x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Axis (wall) + holed 3x3-block pieces; ACTION5 cycles selection axis->pieces->axis, shown by 0-filled holes; ACTION1-4 move selection by 3 (axis vertical only).
Reflections = pieces mirrored across axis centre, clipped to 63x63 play area; holes fill (0/4) only over empty background.
Frame rendered by layer wall<target<reflection<piece and re-extracted: 4-connected components per type (targets per sprite), names sorted by (x,y), wall_h index offset by black pixels in other objects.
Hypothesis resolved: ACTION3 outcome depends on selection (wall vs piece), not the counter (counter never changes, has no pixels).
Unconfirmed: movement bounds/collisions, cycle order beyond piece_0, ACTION6 click-select, ACTION7 undo. Passes with hidden state disabled.
